title: salmer/CppDeveloperRoadmap
summary: A comprehensive GitBook-based learning roadmap for C++ developers that guides users from beginner to intermediate/advanced levels through a structured, self-paced curriculum covering core language features, best practices, and development tools.
problem_solved: Provides a clear, structured learning path for C++ developers to systematically navigate the language's complexity from basics to advanced concepts.
why_valuable: Eliminates learning confusion by offering an organized progression through C++ topics, helping developers avoid common pitfalls and build solid foundations efficiently.
